_doc: Known failures the smoke suite reports as KNOWN instead of FAIL, and unresolved NIDs that are not regressions. A failure entry matches checks by test and check id (fnmatch patterns) and, if given, a regex on the check's detail. When none of an issue's entries fail in a test, the report adds known.<issue> = XPASS: confirm the fix, then delete the entries. See docs/SMOKE.md.
